title: A map and a plan of one manuscript
description: Scenes can be rearranged on the canvas and read one after another in the linear view.

blocks.text: An author needs both an overview of the plot and the sequence of the text. Kept separately, the plan soon stops matching the manuscript.

quote.text: I can outline & draft whole novel scenes, which is my primary use of the program.

blocks.text: Tie every scene node to the text. Switch the view while keeping the order, the notes and the cross-branch links that have been marked explicitly.
Decide in advance how several story lines turn into an order of chapters. Switching the view should not quietly change the author’s sequence.
